title: Construction of the normalized ordinary tensor comparison
statement: Let $(C,J),(D,K)$ be small sites, $uInv\dashv uPush$ a geometric morphism of sheaf topoi with $uInv$ preserving finite limits, $R,RI,S$ commutative ring sheaves, $I$ an algebraic inverse-image presentation of $uInv$ [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], and $c:RI\to S$. Let $L$ be the specified module pullback, with $hobj:L(M)=S\otimes_{RI}I(M)$ and hmap saying that $L(f)$ is extension of scalars of $I(f)$, transported by hobj. Then a normalized CanonicalRingedTensorComparison for these given data exists [def-weil-pbc-canonical-ringed-tensor-comparison]. This statement asserts construction only; uniqueness is proved separately in the parent item.

source.place: Tag 03EL, lemma-tensor-product-pullback; the canonical pure-tensor map and scalar-extension construction

proof.text: Use the normalized tensor comparison for the specified algebraic inverse image, with its simultaneous naturality and generalized pure formula.
Use the proved scalar-extension comparison, natural and normalized on inserted pure sections.

Build the natural iso ε:L≅I.modules⋙T from hobj; hmap is its naturality equation. Whisker and compose the two tensor comparisons with ε. Define q by the scalar-extension unit followed by ε.inv. The unit formula proves q_one; naturality of the composite proves naturality. Its pure formula follows from the inverse-image formula, naturality of the scalar unit, the scalar comparison formula, and naturality of the actual pure pairing.

theorem canonicalRingedTensorComparison_nonempty
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type u))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose JC (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
      R)} (f : M ⟶ N), L.map f =
      eqToHom (hobj M) ≫ changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map f) ≫
        eqToHom (hobj N).symm) :
    Nonempty (CanonicalRingedTensorComparison R S RI uInv I c L hobj)
